claim: When importing an external colour conversion, import colour data keyed by graphics address and never copy its executable snapshot.

evidence.text: The colour conversion's graphics match all 78 player frames and 256 plotter-2 images, but its snapshot differs in state, title data and the lives instruction; colours imported by graphics address, no executable bytes copied.
evidence.quote: but its snapshot differs in state, title data and the lives instruction. Import colours by graphics address;
